arStrings.szText: This is actually both Baby and Giga Belial lines in one. The idea is that Baby Belial says "You face the Lord of Lies" and it transitions to "Come, be crushed like the insects you are!" for Giga Belial's entrance/span
Next line will be "I will drape this world in darkness" spoken by Giga Belial as he spawns, so ideally we could get alts of the these BB lines feeling like they could flow into GB's
You face the Lord of Lies.
